title: Debug Trail: leave the question behind
audience: Developers and inheritors who need to continue an investigation without reconstructing a lost conversation.
promise: Bind a hypothesis to one bounded experiment, preserve redacted evidence, and leave a rerunnable next step.
story: An investigation records a concrete hypothesis and expected result.
The declared command is previewed with target identity and read-only scope.
A human authorizes the experiment; output is bounded, redacted, and hashed.
The conclusion and next step travel in a target-bound continuation receipt.
verified_locally: The fixture command preview reports a fresh repository target and read-only mutation class.
The authorized command passes and emits bounded redacted evidence.
The receipt preserves the target, hypothesis, result, disposition, omission, and rerun interface.
The current clean dev checkout passes the repository test, lint, and package checks.
The 1600×900 PNG preview is visually reviewed and legible at the target crop.
open_gates: Directly exercise VS Code trail creation, receipt opening, and continuation.
Add the remaining stale, failed, cancelled, and rerunnable scenario captures.
Verify a hosted no-auth case page.
Record external GitHub, portfolio, and Handshake readbacks.
claim_boundary: This packet proves the current clean dev checkout's W1 headless trail and receipt workflow plus a local binary preview; it does not prove direct IDE acceptance, hosting, or publication.
